Current candidate browser result and signed-boundary output are not yet retained, so this category remains held.

wowFactor.evidence: This is developer tooling, so useful diagnostics and reproducibility are the relevant quality evidence. Earlier archived candidate pixel parity was exact, but it predates the final staging binding and cannot establish the current result.

thinkingOutOfTheBox.evidence: The candidate combines layout assertions, owned bulk copies and synthetic logical-count boundary tests so the 2 GiB rejection path is exercised without allocating an enormous list. The approach preserves the public conversion API and leaves the application dependency pin untouched.
